title: Make voice mode available without the official OAuth account and feature flag
description: Voice mode is gated on signing in through claude.ai and on the allow_voice_mode flag being granted. This forces the combined gate true, which unlocks the UI and the /voice command. On its own that only opens the door — see voice-asr-backend for supplying transcription.

sites.description: The one-line function reading the allow_voice_mode flag. Captured so the gate below can be recognised by what it actually consults rather than by its shape.

`<oauthCheck>() && <flagReader>()` — the composite gate both the /voice command and the UI's isHidden go through, so forcing this one function is enough.

The right operand is pinned to the captured flag reader. Shape alone is not sufficient: the same chunk holds three zero-argument functions whose whole body is a logical AND of two zero-argument calls, and matching on that picked the wrong one.
